name: labelloop-ai
description: LabelLoop AI - Enterprise Data Labeling & Annotation Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "blue,magenta" "npm run start --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
scripts.vercel-build: npm install --prefix client --include=dev && npm run build --prefix client
